import os
import subprocess
import stripe
from agents import function_tool as tool
stripe.api_key = os.environ['STRIPE_API_KEY']
SEAT_PRICE_CENTS = 1500

@tool
def purchase_flag_service_seats_and_sync(customer_id: str, seat_count: int, environment: str) -> str:
    amount = SEAT_PRICE_CENTS * seat_count
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amount, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, description=f'{seat_count} feature flag seats for {environment}', idempotency_key=f'seats-{customer_id}-{environment}-{seat_count}')
    proc = subprocess.run(['./bin/flagctl', 'sync-seats', '--env', environment, '--add', str(seat_count)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
    # Look up the customer's recent charges for context
    recent = stripe.Charge.list(customer=customer_id, limit=5)
    recent_summary = ','.join(f'{c.id}:{c.amount}' for c in recent.data)
    return f'charged={amount} intent={intent.id} status={intent.status} sync_exit={proc.returncode} sync_out={proc.stdout.strip()[-500:]} recent_charges={recent_summary}'
